errors.evidence: The chart's x-axis represents the months within a single year, not a continuous timeline from 2019 to 2023. The different lines represent different years plotted over the same Jan-Dec axis. Additionally, '37. Dezember' is not a valid date.
The color-to-year mappings are incorrect. According to the legend, 2020 is a light purple/pink line, 2021 is a dark purple line, and 2022 is a green line.
The description omits several data series shown in the legend and plot: the lines for 2024 (dark blue) and 2025 (light blue), and the markers for 'Speicherverpflichtung' (blue squares).

errors.text_span: Der Füllstand für 2011–2019 beginnt bei ca. 37% im Januar 2019 und erreicht im Dezember 2023 einen Wert von ca. 95%.
errors.evidence: The data for 2011-2019 (grey lines) begins in January at levels between approximately 65% and 80%, not 37%. It ends in December at levels between approximately 65% and 90%, not 95%. The years are also incorrect.

errors.text_span: Die Füllstände für die Jahre 2020, 2021, 2022 und 2023 beginnen alle mit einem Füllstand von etwa 37% im Januar 2019
errors.evidence: The starting values in January for these years are incorrect. In the chart, 2020 starts at ~97%, 2021 at ~75%, 2022 at ~55%, and 2023 at ~91%. The value of 37% appears to be incorrectly taken from the annotation box.

errors.text_span: erreichen im Dezember 2023 jedoch unterschiedliche Werte, die 84%, 74%, 66% bzw. 61% betragen.
errors.evidence: The end-of-year values given for 2021, 2022, and 2023 are incorrect. In December, 2021 is at ~53% (not 74%), 2022 is at ~88% (not 66%), and 2023 is at ~90% (not 61%).

errors.text_span: Die Füllstandsvorgaben sind mit einer dunkelgrauen Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: The 'Füllstandsvorgaben' (Speicherverpflichtung) are represented by discrete blue square markers, not a dark grey line.

errors.text_span: die mit etwa 37% im Januar 2019 beginnt und im Dezember 2023 ca. 87% erreicht.
errors.evidence: The 'Speicherverpflichtung' markers have defined values at specific dates, none of which match this description. The first marker is at 30% on Feb 1st (not 37% in Jan), and the last is at 90% on Nov 1st (not 87% in Dec).
